name: lunea
description: LUNEA — платформа записи в салоны красоты

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
